Method of Attack: Leverages the bidirectional algorithm in Unicode encoding to reorder words and characters, deceiving human reviewers while resulting in malicious functionality at runtime
Early Returns: Causes a 'return' statement that appears to be in a comment to execute, potentially excluding wanted functionality
Commenting-Out: Prevents code from being executed by commenting out code snippets that look normal to human reviewers but are ignored at runtime
Stretched Strings: Alters string comparison operations by causing portions of string literals to visually appear as code
Homoglyphs: Uses visually similar characters in function names to mislead reviewers into thinking a specific function is called, while another with malicious functionality is executed
Attack Vector: Source code manipulation using Unicode bidirectional algorithm
